children: Farmers & Merchants Bancorp revised President and CEO Lars B. Eller’s employment agreement, extending its term and increasing his base pay and restricted stock grants.
President and Chief Executive Officer of Farmers & Merchants State Bank and Farmers & Merchants Bancorp

Term extended to August 31, 2028. Annual base pay rises to $595,000 effective January 1, 2027, subject to upward adjustment. Restricted stock grants increase to 35% of base pay from 25%; director-equivalent stock grants are discontinued.
